title: stellaria tennesseensis
intro: Stellaria tennesseensis, commonly known as Tennessee starflower, is a perennial plant native to North America. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tennessee starflower involve anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Tennessee starflower contribute to its potential therapeutic uses, including treating skin conditions and infections.
